summary: Investigation completed at the exact head with fresh logs and JUnit XML. The focused test passed 5/5 on the unmodified head. A temporary mutation then stopped retrying only copyFileTo and copyFileFrom (leaving copyIndexFileTo and copyIndexFileFrom unchanged); the same focused test still passed 5/5. The coverage gap is confirmed: testAllCopyMethodsRetry asserts only the total attempt count of 4, and the first call (copyIndexFileFrom) absorbs both the injected failure and its retry, so the other two methods are only ever exercised on successful calls. Removing retry delegation from copyFileTo/copyFileFrom is therefore undetected.
